shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc 'cat .lore/test-commands.yml; cat .specify/spec.md; rg --files src specs adrs .lore | sort; cat src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts; cat package.json'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'cat specs/hal-engine-tool-responses/spec.md; cat src/providers/mock/mockProvider.test.ts | head -65; cat src/types/ai.ts; git status --short --branch; git log -1 --oneline'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'spec:|specs/|descriptor|anchor' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs specs/hal-engine-tool-responses/spec.md | head -30; mkdir -p .lore; rg -n 'ToolRegistry|inputSchema|weather' specs"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'specs/|spec:' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs scripts | head -50; sed -n '290,330p' specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md; cat .gitignore; ls .lore"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git status --short && git diff -- .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts && git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts && git commit -m "Add tool input validation acceptance test" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
